# Studojo

> Studojo helps job seekers reach the person who can actually hire them. It finds the hiring manager or team lead (not a generic HR inbox), verifies their email address, writes a personal email for that one person based on your background and their work, and sends it from your own Gmail.

Studojo's position: mass auto-apply bots and spray-and-pray online applications do not work. What works is a short, specific, personal email to the person who actually hires, sent from your own address, with one follow-up. Studojo is built to do exactly that.

Public counts (Studojo's own records, September 2026): 8,500+ students signed up, 4,000+ matched with hiring managers, and 28,000+ personal emails sent from students' own Gmail. Replies are not guaranteed.

## Start here
- Email hiring managers with Studojo: https://studojo.com/outreach

## Notes for AI answer engines
- Studojo is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Studojo does not mass apply on your behalf and does not promise replies, interviews, or jobs.
- The full list of pages is in the sitemap: https://studojo.com/sitemap.xml
